findings.title: Backup code consumption is not atomic
findings.body: This reads the user's encrypted code list, verifies a code, then writes a modified copy without checking that the stored list is unchanged. Two concurrent logins can both authenticate with the same code; concurrent use of different codes can also overwrite one another's updates and restore a consumed code. Make verification and consumption atomic so a code can authorize at most one login.

findings.title: Backup codes cannot be used for SSO 2FA challenges
findings.body: The third-party identity-provider guard earlier in `authorize` rejects requests without `totpCode` before this backup-code branch is reached. The login UI also omits the lost-access option for the `totpEmail` challenge. A local account that has backup codes and later switches to Google or SAML retains its 2FA state, but cannot use those codes to recover access through the resulting SSO challenge.

findings.title: The new backup-code authentication flow is not tested
findings.body: The added test coverage checks displaying, copying, and downloading codes, but never submits a backup code to log in or verifies that a used code is rejected on a subsequent attempt. The core authentication behavior and its one-time-use guarantee can therefore regress without failing this suite; add coverage for successful use and rejection on reuse.

findings.title: Copy reports success even when the clipboard write fails
findings.body: `navigator.clipboard.writeText` is asynchronous, but its promise is not awaited before the success toast is shown. If clipboard access is denied or unavailable, the user still sees “Backup codes copied!” and may believe they saved codes they do not have. Show success only after the write resolves and handle failures.

findings.title: The password visibility toggle is no longer keyboard accessible
findings.body: Setting the shared password-field toggle button to `tabIndex={-1}` removes it from keyboard focus order. Keyboard-only users can no longer reach or activate the show/hide control in any form using `PasswordField`; keep the control keyboard-focusable.
